# Numena: Brand

> The brand identity, voice, and design system for Numena — a workspace for psychologists to connect observations, hypotheses, evidence, and decisions, with every conclusion traceable.

This repository is written to be read by people and by AI agents. It is a set of Markdown documents in five numbered sections. Every document describes itself through YAML front matter, and the whole set is indexed in `manifest.json`.

## Read first

- [manifest.json](manifest.json): machine-readable index of every document (section, order, status, summary).
- [brand-guide.md](brand-guide.md): a one-page human summary of the whole brand.

## Sections

- [01 Strategy](01-strategy/README.md): context, audience, purpose, vision, positioning, promise, principles.
- [02 Meaning](02-meaning/README.md): central idea, name and origin, belief, story, semantic framework.
- [03 Character](03-character/README.md): personality, tensions, voice and tone, verbal identity.
- [04 Visual Semantics](04-visual-semantics/README.md): creative direction, visual concepts, rationale.
- [05 Visual System](05-visual-system/README.md): logo, color, typography, graphic elements, iconography, imagery, layout, usage rules.

## How to read this repository (for agents)

1. Start with `manifest.json` for the map. Use each document's `status` to skip placeholders (`stub`).
2. Open a section's `README.md` for its reading order, then read its documents in order.
3. Every document begins with front matter: `title`, `section`, `order`, `status` (`stub`, `draft`, `in-review`, `approved`), `summary`.
4. Cross-references are relative Markdown links.
5. Brand assets live in `assets/`; the presentation lives in `web/` and is not needed for brand work.

## Conventions

- File names are kebab-case; sections are numbered and read in order.
- A `stub` has no content yet; a `draft` is in progress.
- Validate front matter and links and regenerate the index with:

  ```sh
  node scripts/build-manifest.mjs
  ```
